document:10:508:0.text:
A neon carp worth a staggering one million gold has made a splash in the fish market, stirring widespread interest among the nobles!

Baron Grandet, its current owner, made a public statement at his residence in the upper district:

"... This is no ordinary fish! It's a <style="highlight">neon carp</style> valued at one million gold!" The affluent nobleman emphasized, "One million gold!"

According to the baron, the fish is a rare variant of carp. Its worth lies not in its appearance, but in its medicinal properties...

Neon carp soup is said to <style="highlight">cure all ailments and grant immortality</style>.

The ailing King Maximilian is the first thought that comes to mind when one speaks of this fish.

Due to His Majesty's critical condition, the Queen has assumed the regency. However, Her Majesty appears to lack the requisite political acumen.

To date, Her Majesty has resolved neither the succession dispute nor the escalating tensions along the borders with Bantus.

If the fish is indeed the right cure for His Majesty, Savannah's political landscape may be poised for another upheaval!

In the meantime, one cannot help but question whether the royal court has truly done enough to cure the king, when a baron can acquire the remedy with such ease.

Could the Queen be reluctant to relinquish power? Or is Her Majesty deliberately delaying the King's recovery to secure an advantage for Princess Peggy in the succession?
document:10:508:0.source_cn:
贵族圈最近出了一件大新闻。沉寂已久的鱼类市场，终于迎来了大新闻：一条价值百万的天价霓光鲤，横空出世！
放出新闻的正是它目前的持有者，葛朗台男爵。这位豪横的贵族先生，昨日于他位处上城区黄金地段的豪宅中当众放话：
“——这可不是一条普通的鲤鱼！而是价值百万金的<style="highlight">霓光鲤</style>——”葛朗台男爵如此强调，“足足百万金！”
男爵向我报透露：这是鲤鱼的稀有变种，一种富含魔力的“神鱼”。它真正的妙用不在于观赏，而是其药用价值……
据说，喝了霓光鲤熬煮的汤，就能<style="highlight">百病全消，长生不老</style>。
此话一出，不少人第一时间联想到了如今病重的国王陛下。
众所周知，陛下健康状态欠佳，一直由王后摄政。但遗憾的是，她似乎并不具备相应的政治天赋。
不仅王位继承一事上纷争不断，班题斯与王国边境发生摩擦一事上，王后也未积极采取应战措施。
倘若霓光鲤真的有如此神奇的药效，能够令陛下恢复健康，赛凡纳的政治局面或许又将发生剧变！
同时，这不禁让我们心生疑惑：一位男爵都能找到应症的解药，为何声称一直在积极治疗的王室却始终没有找到治疗方法？
或许是王后醉心权势，不愿放手？又或许与王位继承有关，毕竟佩吉公主年纪尚幼，适当拖延时间可以加大她的赢面？……

document:28:509:0.text:
Your Majesty,

Since receiving word of His Majesty's grave condition, I have been consumed with such concern that I have found no rest at night.

Even the finest king salmon at breakfast could not distract me from thoughts of His Majesty's exemplary governance. Each time I closed my eyes to rest, I found myself recalling his countless contributions to Savannah's prosperity.

Even while watching the ballet performance by the famous Pavlova, my thoughts remained with His Majesty...

Ah, what would become of Savannah without His Majesty at the helm? And what a heavy burden would then fall upon Your Majesty! At this thought, I was brought to tears and overcome with emotion...

Thus, I dispatched my men far and wide in search of a cure for the King. At last, my efforts have borne fruit!

I have found an exceedingly rare fish known as the neon carp, whose broth is said to grant eternal youth and cure all ailments.

It cost me one million gold, but for the sake of His Majesty and Your Majesty, every gold was well spent!

However, given the fish's fragile nature, I was reluctant to risk transporting it myself. So, I have kept it in a river close to my residence.

I humbly request that Your Majesty dispatch a guard to <style="highlight">the river near the upper district's arched bridge</style> <style="highlight">tomorrow morning</style> to collect the fish.

Your faithful servant, Baron Grandet
document:28:509:0.source_cn:
尊敬的王后陛下：
自从听说国王陛下病重，葛朗台我，一直心急如焚、夜不能寐！
早上吃着极品的帝王鲑，我却只顾着回忆国王陛下的英明政举；中午午休，我一闭上眼，就想起陛下为赛凡纳的付出；
就连晚上去欣赏舞者帕夫洛娃的芭蕾舞剧，我还是在想着陛下——
啊，要是失去了陛下，赛凡纳该成什么样！王后陛下又该如何劳累！一想到这里，我就泪流满面，痛心不已……
于是，我特意派人四处搜寻能救国王的药。终于，功夫不负有心人，我找到了这条神鱼！
这种名叫霓光鲤的鱼，只是喝了用它熬煮的鱼汤就能令青春常驻；像是这种罕有的极品还能直接入药，喝了就能百病全消！
尽管买下它，花了我足足百万金的巨款……但为了国王陛下与王后陛下，这一切—都是值得的！
只是霓光鲤十分娇贵，我担心自己运输出了问题，就先养在了家附近的河道。
<style="highlight">明日上午</style>，还请王后陛下派遣守备军前往<style="highlight">上城区拱桥附近的河道</style>，亲自带走神鱼，以保神鱼安全无虞！
——您最忠诚的葛朗台男爵，敬上

say:15:1721210014:1.text: The palace's own envoy, none other than the illustrious Magister Merlin, will personally retrieve the legendary miracle fish, the neon carp!
say:15:1721210014:1.source_cn: ——由王宫派出的特使——当然，也就是我们众望所归的大魔...
say:15:1721210014:1.male: The palace's own envoy, none other than the illustrious Magister Merlin, will personally retrieve the legendary miracle fish, the neon carp!
say:15:1721210014:1.female: The palace's own envoy, none other than the illustrious Magister Merlin, will personally retrieve the legendary miracle fish, the neon carp!

say:17:1721210015:1.source_cn: 没错！为了让霓光鲤以最佳状态献到诸位手上，我特意包下了...

say:18:1721210016:1.text: And now, Magister Merlin, the honor is yours. Please catch the miracle fish and present it to Her Majesty!
say:18:1721210016:1.source_cn: 现在，就请梅林阁下亲自捞取神鱼，献给王后陛下！
say:18:1721210016:1.male: And now, Magister Merlin, the honor is yours. Please catch the miracle fish and present it to Her Majesty!
say:18:1721210016:1.female: And now, Magister Merlin, the honor is yours. Please catch the miracle fish and present it to Her Majesty!

choice:16:1:2.text: Hold on. The fish is still in the water?
choice:16:1:2.male: Hold on. The fish is still in the water?
choice:16:1:2.female: Hold on. The fish is still in the water?

say:0:1721211001:0.text: Ah! Magister Merlin, what a lovely cast. Anyone can see that luck is on your side today!
say:0:1721211001:0.source_cn: 啊呀！梅林阁下钓鱼的姿势真是优美，今后能一定走大运！
say:0:1721211001:0.male: Ah! Magister Merlin, what a lovely cast. Anyone can see that luck is on your side today!
say:0:1721211001:0.female: Ah! Magister Merlin, what a lovely cast. Anyone can see that luck is on your side today!

say:1:1721211002:0.text: Strange... There's no trace of magic coming from the fish.
say:1:1721211002:0.source_cn: 奇怪……从鱼身上感受不到任何的魔法波动。
say:1:1721211002:0.male: Strange... There's no trace of magic coming from the fish.
say:1:1721211002:0.female: Strange... There's no trace of magic coming from the fish.

say:1:1721212001:0.text: You close your eyes and focus, feeling for even the faintest stir of magic.
say:1:1721212001:0.source_cn: 你闭上双眼，细心感受着指尖流动着的魔法波动。
say:1:1721212001:0.male: You close your eyes and focus, feeling for even the faintest stir of magic.
say:1:1721212001:0.female: You close your eyes and focus, feeling for even the faintest stir of magic.

say:2:1721212002:1.text: Nothing. Absolutely nothing. The plump fish merely stares back at you with the blank innocence of a creature that has never had a single thought in its life, then blows one pathetic bubble.
say:2:1721212002:1.source_cn: ——没有。你什么也没有感受到。肥美的大鱼呆呆地望着你，...
say:2:1721212002:1.male: Nothing. Absolutely nothing. The plump fish merely stares back at you with the blank innocence of a creature that has never had a single thought in its life, then blows one pathetic bubble.
say:2:1721212002:1.female: Nothing. Absolutely nothing. The plump fish merely stares back at you with the blank innocence of a creature that has never had a single thought in its life, then blows one pathetic bubble.

say:3:1721212003:0.text: No doubt about it. This is just an ordinary carp that happened to mutate a little and ended up with some extra patterning on its fins.
say:3:1721212003:0.source_cn: 毫无疑问，这就是一条普通的鲤鱼，只因为变异，在鱼鳍上多...

say:9:1721212005:0.text: Wh-What? No, that can't be right! Look again! This isn't some common river fish—it's the neon carp! I paid a million gold for it!
say:9:1721212005:0.source_cn: 什、什么？！这不可能，绝对不可能！您再看看，这条鱼不可...

say:10:1721212006:0.text: Baron Grandet, you paraded an ordinary fish around as a miracle cure and attempted to pass it off to the royal court as the king's salvation.
say:10:1721212006:0.source_cn: 葛朗台男爵，你谎称这条普通的鱼为所谓的“神鱼”，甚至愚...

say:11:1721212007:0.text: You spread lies for your own advantage and made a mockery of the throne in the process.
say:11:1721212007:0.source_cn: 为牟取个人名利，四处散布谣言，冒犯君权。

say:12:1721212008:1.text: Under the laws of Savannah, that is treason. You are under arrest.
say:12:1721212008:1.source_cn: 依照赛凡纳的律令，你已触冒犯君主罪。守备军将即刻对你实...

say:16:1721212011:1.text: Wait, wait, easy with the arm! This is a misunderstanding! I'm telling you, there's been a mistake!
say:16:1721212011:1.source_cn: 等……哎哟，不要抓我的胳膊！——等一下！这一定是误会，误会！

say:17:1721212012:1.text: I really did pay a million gold for that fish! I didn't make any of this up! I'm the wronged party here! I demand the right to appeal as a baron—
say:17:1721212012:1.source_cn: 我真的花了一百万买这条鱼！我没说谎，我冤枉啊！我不认罪...

say:1:1721213001:0.text: I-I'm not admitting to anything! I paid a fortune for that fish! You can't just glance at it and declare it fake!
say:1:1721213001:0.source_cn: 我、我不认罪！这条鱼我花了百万金，你们凭什么摸一下就说...

choice_prompt:2:1721213001.text: I-I'm not admitting to anything! I paid a fortune for that fish! You can't just glance at it and declare it fake!
choice_prompt:2:1721213001.source_cn: 我、我不认罪！这条鱼我花了百万金，你们凭什么摸一下就说它是假的？

say:4:1721213002:0.text: Are you saying Magister Merlin is wrong?
say:4:1721213002:0.source_cn: 你是在质疑梅林阁下的判断吗？
say:4:1721213002:0.male: Are you saying Magister Merlin is wrong?
say:4:1721213002:0.female: Are you saying Magister Merlin is wrong?

say:5:1721213003:0.text: If you insist, I can have other mages examine it again once we reach the guard base.
say:5:1721213003:0.source_cn: 需要的话，等到了守备军驻地，我可以再请其他魔法师来重新探测。

say:6:1721213004:1.text: N-No! Of course not! I would never dare imply such a thing!
say:6:1721213004:1.source_cn: 呃……这……不、不敢……我绝对没有那个意思！

say:7:1721213005:1.text: And for what it's worth, I paid dearly for that fish! I didn't make this up. And I certainly didn't set out to deceive anyone!
say:7:1721213005:1.source_cn: 可不管怎么说，这鱼都是我真金白银买来的，一分钱都没有少...

say:8:1721213006:1.text: And if the thing really is a fraud, then I'm the poor fool who got cheated. So why, exactly, am I the one being dragged away?!
say:8:1721213006:1.source_cn: 就算鱼真是假的，那我才是受害者！为什么要逮捕我？！

choice_prompt:9:1721213006.text: And if the thing really is a fraud, then I'm the poor fool who got cheated. So why, exactly, am I the one being dragged away?!
choice_prompt:9:1721213006.source_cn: 就算鱼真是假的，那我才是受害者！为什么要逮捕我？！

say:10:1721213007:1.text: H-How was I supposed to know? The man who sold it to me swore it was the legendary neon carp. Said it restored strength, cured anything, all of it...
say:10:1721213007:1.source_cn: 我、我……我怎么知道？！当时卖给我的那个人就说这条鱼是...

say:11:1721213008:1.text: And I thought... if there was even the slightest chance it might help His Majesty, then how could I walk away?
say:11:1721213008:1.source_cn: 我、我就想着，说不定对陛下有用，这才买下了。

say:12:1721213009:1.text: I spent a fortune on that fish for His Majesty's sake. Yes, that's all it was! Whatever that fish turned out to be, my loyalty was real!
say:12:1721213009:1.source_cn: ……对，没错！我花重金买鱼献给王室，不管真的假的，都是...

say:13:1721213010:1.text: I was desperate for some way to help the king. I trusted the wrong man, and I was duped. Call it foolishness, call it bad judgment if you must, but don't call it treason!
say:13:1721213010:1.source_cn: 只是我日夜为了陛下的身体着急，一时心急，才被人骗着买错...

say:14:1721213011:1.text: Unbelievable... I empty my purse, get sold a lie, and now I'm the villain here? Dura above, what a thankless world. A man offers his loyalty to the royal court, only to be clapped in irons for it!
say:14:1721213011:1.source_cn: 哎哟……我花了钱买了鱼，被骗了还要被按个罪名……艾雅在...

choice_prompt:15:1721213011.text: Unbelievable... I empty my purse, get sold a lie, and now I'm the villain here? Dura above, what a thankless world. A man offers his loyalty to the royal court, only to be clapped in irons for it!
choice_prompt:15:1721213011.source_cn: 哎哟……我花了钱买了鱼，被骗了还要被按个罪名……艾雅在上，真是天底下最大的冤枉事，实在太让人寒心了！

say:17:1721213013:1.text: You invited reporters, staged a ceremony, and sold the city a miracle story about curing His Majesty.
say:17:1721213013:1.source_cn: 联系媒体，举办献宝仪式，大肆宣传“能够治愈国王陛下”的...

say:18:1721213014:1.text: If Her Majesty hadn't brought Merlin along, and had actually taken your word for it, that fish might have ended up in the royal medicine cabinet...
say:18:1721213014:1.source_cn: 倘若王后陛下没有请来梅林阁下，真的被你欺瞒，以这条鱼入药……
say:18:1721213014:1.male: If Her Majesty hadn't brought Merlin along, and had actually taken your word for it, that fish might have ended up in the royal medicine cabinet...
say:18:1721213014:1.female: If Her Majesty hadn't brought Merlin along, and had actually taken your word for it, that fish might have ended up in the royal medicine cabinet...

say:19:1721213015:1.text: So go on then, Baron. Explain that part.
say:19:1721213015:1.source_cn: 葛朗台男爵，你打算如何解释这些行为？

say:21:1721213017:1.text: That's enough. You're coming with us.
say:21:1721213017:1.source_cn: 别再费力狡辩了，葛朗台男爵。跟我走一趟吧。

say:22:1721213018:1.text: Save your energy. Once we get to the <style="highlight">guard base</style>, you'll have all the time in the world there to explain yourself.
say:22:1721213018:1.source_cn: 我建议你省着点力气，等到了<style=highlig...

say:23:1721213019:1.text: Sorry, Magister. I'll take him from here.
say:23:1721213019:1.male: Sorry, Magister. I'll take him from here.
say:23:1721213019:1.female: Sorry, Magister. I'll take him from here.

choice:15:0:1.source_cn: 你为什么要特意联系这么多记者？

choice:15:1:2.text: Why not just offer the fish? Why turn it into a spectacle?
choice:15:1:2.source_cn: 你为什么不直接献鱼，而是要在宫外举办仪式？
choice:15:1:2.male: Why not just offer the fish? Why turn it into a spectacle?
choice:15:1:2.female: Why not just offer the fish? Why turn it into a spectacle?

choice:15:2:3.text: You expect us to believe this was only about the king?
choice:15:2:3.source_cn: 你敢说你真是一心为了国王陛下的身体？
choice:15:2:3.male: You expect us to believe this was only about the king?
choice:15:2:3.female: You expect us to believe this was only about the king?

choice:9:0:1.text: You were the one claiming it could save the king.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 宣传这条鱼能救国王性命的，是你吧？
choice:9:0:1.male: You were the one claiming it could save the king.
choice:9:0:1.female: You were the one claiming it could save the king.

choice:9:1:2.text: You declared it a miracle before you had any proof.
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 你未经查证，就说它是国王的救命稻草
choice:9:1:2.male: You declared it a miracle before you had any proof.
choice:9:1:2.female: You declared it a miracle before you had any proof.

choice:9:2:3.text: You passed off a common carp as a cure for the king!
choice:9:2:3.source_cn: 你用普通鲤鱼藐视王室性命，这是事实！
choice:9:2:3.male: You passed off a common carp as a cure for the king!
choice:9:2:3.female: You passed off a common carp as a cure for the king!

choice:2:0:1.text: If it had that kind of power, there'd be magic on it.
choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 如果它真有那么神奇的药效，身上应该有魔法波动
choice:2:0:1.male: If it had that kind of power, there'd be magic on it.
choice:2:0:1.female: If it had that kind of power, there'd be magic on it.

choice:2:1:2.text: There's no magic on this fish.
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 这条鱼身上没有任何魔力
choice:2:1:2.male: There's no magic on this fish.
choice:2:1:2.female: There's no magic on this fish.

choice:2:2:3.text: Ask any mage in town. They'll tell you the same thing.
choice:2:2:3.source_cn: 你随便找个魔法师，都能得到相同的结论
choice:2:2:3.male: Ask any mage in town. They'll tell you the same thing.
choice:2:2:3.female: Ask any mage in town. They'll tell you the same thing.

say:0:1721214001:0.text: This is a disgrace... I've been wronged...

say:0:1721215001:0.text: The fish was a fraud, no question about that. But Grandet didn't seem to be lying either. Did he really pay that much for it?
say:0:1721215001:0.source_cn: 鱼的确只是普通的鱼，但葛朗台的反应也不像说谎……他真花...
say:0:1721215001:0.male: The fish was a fraud, no question about that. But Grandet didn't seem to be lying either. Did he really pay that much for it?
say:0:1721215001:0.female: The fish was a fraud, no question about that. But Grandet didn't seem to be lying either. Did he really pay that much for it?

say:1:1721215002:0.text: Something's off. Better head to the guard base and see what came out of the questioning.
say:1:1721215002:0.source_cn: 有些放心不下，还是去守备军驻地看看情况吧。
say:1:1721215002:0.male: Something's off. Better head to the guard base and see what came out of the questioning.
say:1:1721215002:0.female: Something's off. Better head to the guard base and see what came out of the questioning.

say:1:1721216001:1.text: Good timing, Magister. We've only just finished with Baron Grandet.
say:1:1721216001:1.source_cn: 阁下，您来得正好。对葛朗台男爵的审讯刚刚结束。
say:1:1721216001:1.male: Good timing, Magister. We've only just finished with Baron Grandet.

say:3:1721216002:1.text: He folded almost immediately. The moment we sat him down, the whole story came pouring out.
say:3:1721216002:1.source_cn: 葛朗台男爵吓破了胆，审讯刚开始就一股脑把交易过程全说了出来。
say:3:1721216002:1.male: He folded almost immediately. The moment we sat him down, the whole story came pouring out.
say:3:1721216002:1.female: He folded almost immediately. The moment we sat him down, the whole story came pouring out.

say:4:1721216003:1.text: He swears he had no idea. Says he genuinely believed it was the real thing, paid a fortune for it, and thought presenting it to the royal family would earn him a little glory.
say:4:1721216003:1.source_cn: 他一口咬定自己真的不知情，从头到尾都以为这是条真正的神...
say:4:1721216003:1.male: He swears he had no idea. Says he genuinely believed it was the real thing, paid a fortune for it, and thought presenting it to the royal family would earn him a little glory.
say:4:1721216003:1.female: He swears he had no idea. Says he genuinely believed it was the real thing, paid a fortune for it, and thought presenting it to the royal family would earn him a little glory.

say:7:1721216005:1.source_cn: 具体情况还需要从霓光鲤的交易过程入手，进一步调查。

say:8:1721216006:0.source_cn: 梅林阁下，这是有关交易过程的审讯记录。葛朗台男爵交代了...

say:9:1721216007:0.source_cn: 这份记录以严谨的文字还原了审讯的现场。只是透过文字，你...

say:9:1721216007:0.female: The written record is precise and formal, but even through all that official phrasing, you can practically hear Grandet blubbering through every line...

narration:11:1721216008:0.text: According to Grandet, this all started when he happened to pass by Silken Snare and spotted Count Ramir getting cozy with a woman...
narration:11:1721216008:0.source_cn: 据葛朗台所说，那天他路过丝绒陷阱时，偶然碰见了拉米尔伯...

narration:12:1721216009:0.text: Most people would have kept their heads down and kept moving. Grandet, apparently, is not most people.
narration:12:1721216009:0.source_cn: 常人都该知趣地回避，但葛朗台岂是走寻常路的贵族？

narration:13:1721216010:0.text: He'd been trying to worm his way into Ramir's social circle for ages. Never quite managed it, but that didn't stop him trying.
narration:13:1721216010:0.source_cn: 他崇拜伯爵的头衔，早就想与拉米尔结交，奈何总混不进他的社交圈

narration:14:1721216011:0.text: Grandet, naturally, took the encounter as a gift from fate and cautiously made his way over...
narration:14:1721216011:0.source_cn: 葛朗台将这次偶遇视作难得的机会，小心地凑了上去……

say:16:1721216012:1.text: That place, Silken Snare, is ridiculous. They literally turned away a paying customer!
say:16:1721216012:1.source_cn: 这个叫丝绒陷阱的餐厅真是奇怪，有生意都不做。

say:17:1721216013:1.text: I heard they serve some miracle dish that keeps you young. I was going to try it for you, you know.
say:17:1721216013:1.source_cn: 听说他们有道特殊的菜肴，吃了就能青春常驻。人家为了你，...

say:18:1721216014:1.text: And I couldn't get a table! I even used your name, and they still said no. Can you believe that?! Really, Ramir, you ought to do something about them...
say:18:1721216014:1.source_cn: 结果，连餐位都预约不上！报了你的名字都没用，你说他们讨...

say:20:1721216015:1.text: Behave yourself. And besides, didn't I make it up to you?
say:20:1721216015:1.source_cn: 不许胡闹。再说，我不是又补偿你了吗？

say:21:1721216016:1.text: Well? That soup I sent over, the one made from the neon carp. Worth the trouble, wasn't it?
say:21:1721216016:1.source_cn: 怎么样，用那条霓光鲤熬的汤还不错吧？

say:22:1721216017:1.text: More than worth it. Just look at me. The wrinkles are gone. I look in my twenties again.
say:22:1721216017:1.source_cn: 好得很哪。你瞧我的脸，之前的皱纹都消失不见了，好像回到...

say:23:1721216018:1.text: I thought you were spinning tales when you first mentioned it. I didn't expect it to actually work... So what exactly is this fish?
say:23:1721216018:1.source_cn: 之前听你说的，我还不信呢。没想到效果真的这么神奇……到...

say:24:1721216019:1.text: The fish carries magic in its flesh. It slows the body's decline, and the stronger the magic, the stronger the effect.
say:24:1721216019:1.source_cn: 这种鱼的体内蕴含魔力，能让人能让延缓衰老。体内蕴含魔力...

say:25:1721216020:0.text: The one you tasted was nothing remarkable. A true neon carp, one worthy of the name, can be prepared as medicine. One dose, and illness is swept away. The body restored to its prime!
say:25:1721216020:0.source_cn: 你的这条还算不上什么。真正的、能被称为“神鱼”的霓光鲤...

say:26:1721216021:1.text: So that "miracle dish" at Silken Snare... that's made from this fish?
say:26:1721216021:1.source_cn: 这么说，难道丝绒陷阱的那道特殊菜肴，就是用这种鱼做的？

say:27:1721216022:1.text: Now that would be a trade secret, wouldn't it? Not the sort of thing one shares with just anyone.
say:27:1721216022:1.source_cn: 呀……这算是商业机密了吧？这样天大的秘密，可千万不能告...

say:28:1721216023:1.text: Wouldn't you agree, sir? Since you've been lurking there and listening to every word.
say:28:1721216023:1.source_cn: 你说是吧，那位一直在偷听的先生？

say:32:1721216025:1.text: Baron Grandet, eavesdropping on a private conversation is hardly a polite way to introduce yourself.
say:32:1721216025:1.source_cn: 葛朗台男爵，你是在故意偷听我们谈话？这可不礼貌。

say:33:1721216026:1.text: No, no, Count Ramir, nothing like that. I wasn't eavesdropping. I just... I saw you two talking about that neon carp and... well, I was wondering whether it might be for sale.
say:33:1721216026:1.source_cn: 不、不！拉米尔伯爵，我绝没有偷听的意思。我是……是……...

say:34:1721216027:1.text: Oh? So that caught your attention. What is it, Baron, worried the years are finally starting to catch up to you?
say:34:1721216027:1.source_cn: 买鱼？呵呵……难不成男爵阁下也和我一样，有青春难驻的苦恼？

say:35:1721216028:1.text: Now, now, don't tease him. Baron Grandet has loftier concerns. Instead of worrying about wrinkles, he's always thinking of how to serve the royal court... isn't that right, Baron?
say:35:1721216028:1.source_cn: 不许胡说。葛朗台男爵日日都想着如何为王室分忧，成为一名...

say:36:1721216029:1.text: (The royal court... of course. If that fish really does what they say, then it could help the king...)
say:36:1721216029:1.source_cn: （王室……对了，我怎么没想到！能治百病的鱼，肯定也能治...

say:37:1721216030:1.text: ... Yes, exactly. That's why I came. I want the best neon carp you've got. The rarest one. The one that actually works miracles!
say:37:1721216030:1.source_cn: ……没错，拉米尔伯爵，我来找您，就是想求购那条最厉害、...

say:38:1721216031:1.text: That's not how this works! You don't just walk up and buy one. Even Ramir doesn't have extras lying around!
say:38:1721216031:1.source_cn: 不行！这鱼可不常见，就算是拉米尔手上也没有几条，哪里匀...

say:39:1721216032:1.text: Watch your tone, commoner! Who do you think you're talking to?!
say:39:1721216032:1.source_cn: 你、你——你不过就是个平民，竟敢对我如此无礼！

say:40:1721216033:1.text: Oh, do calm down, Baron Grandet. Why are you letting a girl get under your skin?
say:40:1721216033:1.source_cn: 好了，好了。葛朗台男爵，你和她生什么气？

say:41:1721216034:1.text: I'll be honest with you. The fish you're asking for—the one that can cure any illness—isn't in my possession right now. But I do happen to know where such a fish might be found.
say:41:1721216034:1.source_cn: 实话告诉你吧，吃了能让百病全消的那条霓光鲤，现在还不在...

say:42:1721216035:1.text: And I know why you're asking. Your loyalty to the royal family is plain to see. Believe me, Baron, I care about the court just as deeply.
say:42:1721216035:1.source_cn: 我知道你为什么想买霓光鲤——你对王室的忠心，我自然也有。

say:43:1721216036:1.text: The trouble, though, is the price. It's so expensive that even I had to stop and think twice.
say:43:1721216036:1.source_cn: 可这鱼的价格实在不便宜，即使是我，也可有些负担不起啊。

say:44:1721216037:1.text: Count, you know me. If there's even the slightest chance this could help His Majesty, then the price doesn't matter. Name it. I'll pay!
say:44:1721216037:1.source_cn: 哦，尊敬的伯爵大人！您是最了解我对王室的忠心的，无论多...

say:45:1721216038:1.text: Well, at the current market rate, that fish would cost you... <style="highlight">one million</style>.
say:45:1721216038:1.source_cn: 那条霓光鲤，目前的市场价是……<style=highl...

say:48:1721216041:1.text:
An astonishing figure, I know. But for a fish with that kind of power? And only one on the market? At that price, people would still fight over it.
Of course, if that's too much for you...
say:48:1721216041:1.source_cn: ——是啊，毕竟是药效如此神奇的霓光鲤，仅此一条。就算是...

say:49:1721216042:1.text: No, wait! I'll take it! I said I'd pay, and I will!

say:50:1721216043:0.text: Magnificent. Truly magnificent. Baron Grandet, your devotion does you credit! Very well. Since this is all in service of the royal court, I'll do you a favor and arrange the deal myself...
say:50:1721216043:0.source_cn: 不愧是以慷慨闻名的葛朗台男爵，这份忠心连我都为之惊叹！...

say:53:1721216044:0.text: And that, in Baron Grandet's own words, was how the whole deal happened.
say:53:1721216044:0.source_cn: 这就是葛朗台男爵交代的整个交易过程了。

choice_prompt:54:1721216044.female: And that, in Baron Grandet's own words, was how the whole deal happened.

say:55:1721216045:1.text: We've already found out where he lives in the upper district.
say:55:1721216045:1.source_cn: 是。我们已经查到了拉米尔伯爵在上城区的住址。
say:55:1721216045:1.male: We've already found out where he lives in the upper district.
say:55:1721216045:1.female: We've already found out where he lives in the upper district.

say:56:1721216046:1.text: Magister Merlin, come with me. We're not done yet, and I'd rather have you there for what comes next.
say:56:1721216046:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，请随我一同来吧。接下来的调查，也要麻烦您了。
say:56:1721216046:1.male: Magister Merlin, come with me. We're not done yet, and I'd rather have you there for what comes next.
say:56:1721216046:1.female: Magister Merlin, come with me. We're not done yet, and I'd rather have you there for what comes next.

choice:54:0:1.source_cn: 这个拉米尔伯爵很可疑

choice:54:1:2.text: Looks like he's our best lead.

choice:54:1:2.male: Looks like he's our best lead.
choice:54:1:2.female: Looks like he's our best lead.

choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 我还以为能赶上审讯过程呢
choice:2:1:2.male: Shame. I thought I might make it in time.
choice:2:1:2.female: Shame. I thought I might make it in time.

say:0:1721217001:0.text: Open up! I know you're in there!

say:1:1721217002:0.text: Got the guts to scam people, but not to answer your own door?
say:1:1721217002:0.source_cn: 你有本事诈骗，没本事开门吗！

say:2:1721217003:0.source_cn: 拉米尔已经不在这里了！

say:0:1721218001:0.text: Stop right there! What do you think you're doing?

say:1:1721218002:0.text: A guard? Ha! You're probably covering for that count! Fine by me. I'll take you both on!
say:1:1721218002:0.source_cn: 守备军？哼，你跟那个伯爵也是一伙的！来啊，我连你们一起打！

say:1:1721219001:1.text: A-Alright, alright! I'm done! I won't go in, I swear!
say:1:1721219001:1.source_cn: 别、别打了！我认输，我不进去找拉米尔就是了……

choice_prompt:2:1721219001.text: A-Alright, alright! I'm done! I won't go in, I swear!
choice_prompt:2:1721219001.source_cn: 别、别打了！我认输，我不进去找拉米尔就是了……

say:3:1721219002:1.text: I know, I know, I messed up! I lost my cool, that's all! It's just... a private dispute between me and Count Ramir. We can settle it ourselves!
say:3:1721219002:1.source_cn: 我、我错了，都是我一时昏了头。我只是……只是和拉米尔伯...

choice_prompt:4:1721219002.text: I know, I know, I messed up! I lost my cool, that's all! It's just... a private dispute between me and Count Ramir. We can settle it ourselves!
choice_prompt:4:1721219002.source_cn: 我、我错了，都是我一时昏了头。我只是……只是和拉米尔伯爵有一点小小的矛盾，我们私下里解决就好！

say:8:1721219005:1.text: Let me make something clear. What you just did is a crime.
say:8:1721219005:1.source_cn: 你要清楚，你刚刚的行为属于入室未遂，是犯法的。

say:9:1721219006:1.text: By law, I can arrest you right now and haul you back to the guard base in chains.
say:9:1721219006:1.source_cn: 依照律法，我完全有权将你就地逮捕，带回守备军驻地审讯判刑。

say:10:1721219007:1.text: No, please! D-Don't arrest me! I'm not the one who did wrong here!
say:10:1721219007:1.source_cn: 不、不要抓我！我、我是无辜的，错的又不是我！

say:11:1721219008:1.text: Then give me a reason to believe you. Right now all I have is a man trying to break down a stranger's door.
say:11:1721219008:1.source_cn: 口说无凭，我们不了解你行为的前因后果，凭什么相信你是无辜的？

say:12:1721219009:1.text: So here's your chance. Tell me why you came after Count Ramir.
say:12:1721219009:1.source_cn: 除非，你能给出一个合理的解释，说说你来找拉米尔伯爵的原因。

say:13:1721219010:1.text: If your story sounds reasonable, I may be willing to go easier on you.
say:13:1721219010:1.source_cn: 倘若真是情有可原，我可以考虑酌情减少对你的处罚。

say:15:1721219012:1.text: Only if you tell the truth.

say:17:1721219014:1.text: I made a decent fortune in trade. Thought maybe it was time to buy myself a title, a place among the nobles.
say:17:1721219014:1.source_cn: 我靠着做生意挣了些钱，就想着再买个爵位，以后家里也算是...

say:18:1721219015:1.text: I asked around. People said Ramir handled that sort of thing. So I took most of what I had and went to him.
say:18:1721219015:1.source_cn: 我找人打听，听说拉米尔伯爵在做这个生意。就拿了我大半的...

say:19:1721219016:1.text: He had no problem taking the money. After that, all I got were excuses and delays. By the time I realized what was going on, he was gone!
say:19:1721219016:1.source_cn: 可他收钱很快，爵位的事却一拖再拖！等我发现不对，他已经...

say:20:1721219017:1.text: Now I've got nothing. No title. No money. And who was I supposed to report it to? "Hello, officer, I was illegally trying to buy nobility"? I had nowhere else to go.
say:20:1721219017:1.source_cn: 我现在是权财两空，这事也没法找你们守备军……我实在没办...

choice_prompt:21:1721219017.text: Now I've got nothing. No title. No money. And who was I supposed to report it to? "Hello, officer, I was illegally trying to buy nobility"? I had nowhere else to go.
choice_prompt:21:1721219017.source_cn: 我现在是权财两空，这事也没法找你们守备军……我实在没办法，才只好过来找他算账……

say:23:1721219019:1.text: Go home. I'll look into Count Ramir. But if I catch you doing something like this again, I won't be so patient.
say:23:1721219019:1.source_cn: 你先走吧。拉米尔伯爵的事我会调查，但像今天的事，我不希...

say:25:1721219021:1.text: When he was pounding on the door, someone inside cried for help. She may know something. Let's ask.
say:25:1721219021:1.source_cn: 刚刚他砸门时，门中似乎有人在喊救命。或许她也是知情人…...
say:25:1721219021:1.male: When he was pounding on the door, someone inside cried for help. She may know something. Let's ask.
say:25:1721219021:1.female: When he was pounding on the door, someone inside cried for help. She may know something. Let's ask.

choice:21:0:1.text: So Grandet wasn't the only one who got scammed.
choice:21:0:1.source_cn: 类似霓光鲤的事，他不止干了一次
choice:21:0:1.male: So Grandet wasn't the only one who got scammed.
choice:21:0:1.female: So Grandet wasn't the only one who got scammed.

choice:21:1:2.source_cn: 看来还是个诈骗老手啊

choice:4:0:1.text: You said he scammed you. What was that about?
choice:4:0:1.male: You said he scammed you. What was that about?
choice:4:0:1.female: You said he scammed you. What was that about?

choice:4:1:2.text: By "private dispute," do you mean he scammed you too?
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 你说的矛盾，是他诈骗了你？
choice:4:1:2.male: By "private dispute," do you mean he scammed you too?
choice:4:1:2.female: By "private dispute," do you mean he scammed you too?

choice:2:0:1.text: Why were you trying to force your way into that house?
choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 说，你为什么要私闯民宅？
choice:2:0:1.male: Why were you trying to force your way into that house?
choice:2:0:1.female: Why were you trying to force your way into that house?

choice:2:1:2.female: What do you want with Ramir?

say:3:1721220003:1.text: Dura above... If you hadn't shown up, and he'd gotten inside... I don't even want to think about it...
say:3:1721220003:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上……还好有你们在，不然他今天进了门，我的家就……

Ma'am, I need to ask again, officially this time: is Count Ramir really not here?
say:5:1721220004:1.source_cn: 请放心，那人不会再回来闹事了。\n夫人，我以守备军的身...

say:6:1721220005:1.text: He's connected to an ongoing investigation, and we need him brought in for questioning.
say:6:1721220005:1.source_cn: 他涉及参与到一起案件中，需要跟我们去一趟守备军驻地，配...

say:7:1721220006:1.text: Dura above, he's not here. This house is mine—legally and entirely mine. It has nothing to do with that man!
say:7:1721220006:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，他真的不在这里。这是我的家，是我名下的资产，...

say:8:1721220007:1.text: And neither do I. We're divorced. We simply never made it public.
say:8:1721220007:1.source_cn: 我——我和他也没有关系了。我们已经离婚了，只是没有对外公布。

choice_prompt:9:1721220007.text: And neither do I. We're divorced. We simply never made it public.
choice_prompt:9:1721220007.source_cn: 我——我和他也没有关系了。我们已经离婚了，只是没有对外公布。

say:10:1721220008:1.text: ... It's not something I'm proud of, but I finally reached the point where I couldn't put up with him anymore.
say:10:1721220008:1.source_cn: ……离婚实在不是什么光彩事，只是我实在对他忍无可忍。

say:11:1721220009:1.text: Ramir may have the title of a count, but he has none of the character that should come with it.
say:11:1721220009:1.source_cn: 拉米尔，他占着伯爵的头衔，却丝毫没有身为贵族的能力与品格。

say:12:1721220010:1.text: He lives far beyond his means, and once he picked up gambling, things only got worse. He's nearly burned through everything his family left him.
say:12:1721220010:1.source_cn: 他不仅喜好奢侈，还染上好赌的习惯，已经快把他祖产留的钱...

say:13:1721220011:1.text: And to keep that habit going... Dura above, I'm afraid he's done all sorts of shameful things for money.
say:13:1721220011:1.source_cn: 为了继续赌博，他——艾雅在上，我恐怕他干了许多见不得人...

say:14:1721220012:1.text: Before I left him, scenes like this were common. Angry men at the door, shouting, demanding what he owed them. I couldn't live like that anymore.
say:14:1721220012:1.source_cn: 在我和他离婚前，像刚刚那样的事常常发生。我实在没法忍下...

say:15:1721220013:1.text: What I did not expect was that he would sink this low.
say:15:1721220013:1.source_cn: 但我实在没想到，他竟已彻底忘记了身为贵族应恪守的品格。

say:16:1721220014:1.text: Too much of a coward to face the consequences himself, he started sending people to my door instead...
say:16:1721220014:1.source_cn: 他不敢承担自己欺诈引来的后果，竟向外公开了我的住址……

say:17:1721220015:1.text: That tells us what we needed to know. Thank you, ma'am.
say:17:1721220015:1.source_cn: 大致情况我们都清楚了。感谢您提供的信息，夫人。
say:17:1721220015:1.male: That tells us what we needed to know. Thank you, ma'am.
say:17:1721220015:1.female: That tells us what we needed to know. Thank you, ma'am.

say:18:1721220016:1.text: If anything like this happens again, send for the guards. We'll come straight away.
say:18:1721220016:1.source_cn: 如果再有类似的情况，请直接联系附近的守备军，我们一定会...

say:18:1721220016:1.female: If anything like this happens again, send for the guards. We'll come straight away.

narration:20:1721220017:0.source_cn: 伯爵夫人面带忧虑地点了点头，重新锁好了门……

say:22:1721220018:1.text: At this moment, there are two things we can say for certain about Count Ramir.
say:22:1721220018:1.source_cn: 阁下，关于拉米尔伯爵，现在有两点信息可以确认。
say:22:1721220018:1.male: At this moment, there are two things we can say for certain about Count Ramir.
say:22:1721220018:1.female: At this moment, there are two things we can say for certain about Count Ramir.

say:23:1721220019:1.text: First, he has a serious gambling problem and a habit of spending lavishly, even though he's short on money. That makes him reckless when he needs cash.
